goal_title: Randomness and noise: evidence-led hall route
why: Move from demonstrated mechanisms to open experiments, without silently destroying old halls or manuscript connections.
success_criteria: Tracked, local and runtime orders compared; no accidental changes to authorial route
Proposed change list and cross-hall handovers accepted by the author
Every changed hall traversable in map checker and headset, with code/VR verification distinguished
Existing task issues explicitly referenced rather than duplicated

tasks.title: Freeze and reconcile all source orders
tasks.spec: On the working computer compare git status, commons/maps/sequences/randomness.json, commons/maps/sequences/noise.json, commons/maps/sequences/particles.json, commons/maps/curriculum_spine.json and the current runtime-authored order (including any local map_authored.json or generated plan). Also compare the September 2026 randomness-review.md and noise-review.md snapshots and doc/tasks/book_randomness.json, book_noise.json. Inventory every hall map_data.json interactables layer. Mark items as tracked, locally modified, planned or unverified; do not treat uncommitted work as missing. Save discrepancies and hashes in doc/tasks/_audits/random_noise_particle_route_state.md; make no edits to routes.
tasks.verification: git status --short; python tools/ada/ada.py seq randomness; python tools/ada/ada.py seq noise

tasks.title: Resolve physical route versus teaching order
tasks.spec: Prepare two columns: tracked sequence maps[] order and actual Endless Museum runtime route (including Biome_Cage and Biome_Ladder_Randomness if still present). Compare with the proposal in ADA_RANDOMNESS_NOISE_PARTICLES_PLAN.md. Keep all teleporters, gating and previous lesson references intact until human approval. Write an explicit change list with old index, proposed index and dependencies, including any question about Lab_Path not being built. Do not modify a map in this task.
tasks.verification: Review generated order against commons/maps/sequences/*.json and existing runtime route

tasks.title: Reconcile the seeded opening and textile move
tasks.spec: Inspect commons/maps/Random_Definition/map_data.json and final.md, commons/maps/Randomness_10_PRINT_Algorithm/map_data.json and final.md, and the newer illustrated review. Identify whether textile_comparison is still physically in Random_Definition or already moved locally; confirm seed_replay_demo, RAND page, sphere and the 4x4 mode in source. Propose exactly one move, not a duplicate. Document the inherited mechanism and what changed.
tasks.verification: Compare actual map token counts in both interactables layers and inspect local git diff

tasks.title: Trial the early probability route without permanently reordering
tasks.spec: Create a proposal/capture test for Random_Definition → Random_Entropy → Random_Cubes → Random_Gaussian → Random_Remove → Randomness_10_PRINT_Algorithm. Explain why coin/die and distributions may need to precede removal and grammar. Keep current canonical order until human review of one walk-through and existing final.md handovers; maintain existing map names. Do not alter locked gates in this task.
tasks.verification: Compare trial experience with current route; record approval or rejection explicitly

tasks.title: Design the later randomness exploration arc
tasks.spec: Design an encounter-by-encounter movement through Random_Rotate_Random_XYZ, Random_Walk, Random_Mushrooms, Random_Space_Geometry, Randomness_Examples_of_Randomness, Random_Pheromone, Random_Space and Random_Game. Keep the installed anchor for each; mark new proposals separately. Include the existing book_randomness.001 unreachable-geometry issue and book_randomness.028 path severance as prerequisites before physical carrying. Specify what the visitor may preserve, predict, vary or discover in each hall.
tasks.verification: Artifact-by-artifact walkability and narrative dependency review

tasks.title: Decide noise hall order and field handoff
tasks.spec: Compare existing noise hall order with the proposal to put Noise_Perlin_Simplex before Noise_Space_10, leaving Noise_Space_10 as open investigation. Check Lab_Path presence in actual runtime versus prose (existing book_noise.014) and whether Chamber_Noise is in use or deferred. Do not silently activate Noise_Blue, Noise_Functions or Noise_Volume. Write a route decision and concrete edit diff only after approval.
tasks.verification: Cross-check route, return_to and portal state against the actual manager and sequence files

tasks.title: Specify an opt-in cross-hall experiment record
tasks.spec: Design a minimal JSON run record to carry captured seed and source classification, generator version, parameters, draw order, timestamp/build, observation and uncertainty labels between halls. Do not assume the museum already persists this state. Include explicit export/import, clear/reset and provenance; do not collect raw pose/audio data without separate necessity and consent. Name producer and consumer artifacts and test both same-hall replay and cross-hall restore. Write schema and example.

tasks.title: Plan minimal map diffs without erasing local work
tasks.spec: After signed route decisions, specify per-map JSON cell edits, source paths, teleporter checks, collision clearance and staging. Reconcile the existing registry entries first; do not recreate curl_noise_particles or noise_mixer which are already present on the tracked branch. Preserve local uncommitted map edits and historical snapshots. Include before/after map plans and rollback steps.
tasks.verification: python tools/map_pathfinder.py check --all; human approval of plan before writing map_data.json

tasks.title: Verify route, transfers and headset experience
tasks.spec: After map edits have been implemented by separately approved tasks, validate all touched maps with python tools/map_pathfinder.py check <MapName> --verbose and then python tools/map_pathfinder.py check --all. Run an actual Godot scene load and VR headset traversal. Verify approaches, visibility, reach, reset, save/replay, performance, teleporter progression and return-to-Lab. Record failures, build/commit IDs and headset tests; do not present desktop checks as headset evidence.
tasks.verification: python tools/map_pathfinder.py check --all; headset acceptance record attached
